definitions.primary: raw_latency = real public receive_last - independent public A first_valid; no BAG or link subtraction
definitions.true_first: earliest source message per (source endpoint, real reset epoch, public VLID), across all stages and windows
definitions.repeated_group: same direction, epoch, public VLID and payload length; per-stage and complete cross-stage populations reported separately
definitions.due: previous same-VL internal slow-line TX start + current configured BAG; diagnostic perf_ref.measure anchor
definitions.signed_residuals: due-core_M and due-public_first are retained with their sign; first has no previous BAG deadline
definitions.waiting: physical remaining eligibility wait is the positive signed residual, otherwise zero; first has zero BAG wait
definitions.adjusted: raw minus core wait / raw minus public wait are separate diagnostics; negative adjusted values are retained
definitions.limit: threshold statements apply to jitter range, not individual raw latency; singleton groups receive no pass verdict
definitions.short_only: C1561: 既然已经分片，不再受单帧限制。 No long-message latency formula is inferred or tested.

matching: independent public A VLID+exact payload -> configured core M; receiver C map -> D VLID+exact payload; both GMII networks TX/RX FCS/header/length/payload and complete counts verified

raw_latency_all.scope: heterogeneous descriptive distribution; not a same-(VL,n) jitter verdict
